# Jobs — Evidence

## Findings
<a id="findings"></a>

- <a id="research.backend-src-jobs.15c336b3"></a>**1. JobsController is a NestJS controller mapped to the api/jobs route and tagged jobs for Swagger.**
  [`jobs.controller.ts:15-16`](../jobs.controller.ts#L15-L16)
- <a id="research.backend-src-jobs.bffe2d79"></a>**2. The JobsModule NestJS module declares JobsController as its controller and registers JobsService as both a provider and an export.**
  [`jobs.module.ts:5-10`](../jobs.module.ts#L5-L10)
- <a id="research.backend-src-jobs.8217c5a9"></a>**3. The index.ts barrel file re-exports the jobs module, service, controller, and the DTO index.**
  [`index.ts:1-5`](../index.ts#L1-L5)
- <a id="research.backend-src-jobs.e390b3e8"></a>**4. The application root AppModule imports JobsModule to wire the jobs feature into the application.**
  [`app.module.ts:9-9`](../../app.module.ts#L9-L9)
  [`app.module.ts:29-29`](../../app.module.ts#L29-L29)
- <a id="research.backend-src-jobs.d01fa15b"></a>**5. JobsService is an @Injectable() service whose getJobById method always throws a NotFoundException with status code 404 and message JOB_NOT_FOUND, because jobs are not stored in stateless mode.**
  [`jobs.service.ts:3-24`](../jobs.service.ts#L3-L24)
- <a id="research.backend-src-jobs.06a68913"></a>**6. JobsController imports JobStatusDto and JobResultDto from the jobs DTO index, JobStatus from the common types, and ErrorResponseDto from the common DTOs.**
  [`jobs.controller.ts:10-13`](../jobs.controller.ts#L10-L13)
- <a id="research.backend-src-jobs.8c37981b"></a>**7. The getJobStatus endpoint is rate-limited to 100 requests per 60 seconds by the @Throttle decorator.**
  [`jobs.controller.ts:21-21`](../jobs.controller.ts#L21-L21)
- <a id="research.backend-src-jobs.289fb29a"></a>**8. JobsController.getJobStatus handles GET api/jobs/:id, validates the id with ParseUUIDPipe, and returns a JobStatusDto assembled from the job returned by JobsService.getJobById.**
  [`jobs.controller.ts:20-21`](../jobs.controller.ts#L20-L21)
  [`jobs.controller.ts:101-114`](../jobs.controller.ts#L101-L114)
- <a id="research.backend-src-jobs.681c0b98"></a>**9. JobsController.getJobResult handles GET api/jobs/:id/result, validates the id with ParseUUIDPipe, and throws a BadRequestException with message JOB_NOT_COMPLETED when the job's status is not COMPLETED.**
  [`jobs.controller.ts:116-116`](../jobs.controller.ts#L116-L116)
  [`jobs.controller.ts:257-268`](../jobs.controller.ts#L257-L268)
- <a id="research.backend-src-jobs.1070c31f"></a>**10. When the job is completed, getJobResult returns a JobResultDto whose events are taken from job.result, defaulting to an empty array when the result is absent.**
  [`jobs.controller.ts:270-273`](../jobs.controller.ts#L270-L273)
- <a id="research.backend-src-jobs.111c1710"></a>**11. Because JobsService.getJobById always throws a NotFoundException, both controller endpoints currently fail every request with a 404 JOB_NOT_FOUND response.**
  [`jobs.controller.ts:104-104`](../jobs.controller.ts#L104-L104)
  [`jobs.controller.ts:260-260`](../jobs.controller.ts#L260-L260)
  [`jobs.service.ts:13-24`](../jobs.service.ts#L13-L24)
